dossier.purpose: Go CLI by Truffle Security that scans git history plus staged changes, filesystems and about 15 other sources (GitHub/GitLab orgs, S3, GCS, Docker images, Postman, Jenkins, Elasticsearch, Hugging Face, syslog, stdin) for leaked credentials (main.go:100-295). About 890 regex detectors are registered (pkg/engine/defaults/defaults.go:905-1913). By default each candidate is verified against the issuing service's API and labelled verified, unverified or unknown (README.md:424-430). Verification is built into the same binary; there is no separate verifier component. `trufflehog analyze` is a separate subcommand that queries provider APIs for permissions on 43 credential types (pkg/analyzer/cli.go:63-155). Also shipped as a Docker image, a GitHub Action (action.yml) and a pre-commit hook manifest (.pre-commit-hooks.yaml). Truffle Security also sells a commercial monitoring product (README.md:31-35); CODEOWNERS assigns the repo to two Truffle teams, 'integrations' and 'scanning' (CODEOWNERS:1-17).

claims.claim: Looks for secrets in 'Git, chats, wikis, logs, API testing platforms, object stores, filesystems and more'.
Classifies 'over 800 secret types', mapping each back to the identity it belongs to.
'For every secret TruffleHog can classify, it can also log in to confirm if that secret is live or not.'
For '20 some' commonly leaked credential types, `trufflehog analyze` sends many requests to show who created the credential, what it can access and its permissions.

v3 added 'over 700 credential detectors that support active verification'. Verification yields three statuses: verified, unverified, unknown (unknown = verification failed due to a network or API error).

Local git repos are cloned to a temp dir before scanning to guard against malicious git configs (CVE-2025-41390). `--clone-path` picks the location; `--trust-local-git-config` scans in place (trusted repos only).

CI usage: `trufflehog git file://. --since-commit main --branch feature-1 --results=verified,unknown --fail`. 'The `--fail` flag will return an 183 error code if valid credentials are found.' Exit codes are 0 (clean), 1 (error), 183 (results found, only with --fail).

Available as a GitHub Action (`trufflesecurity/trufflehog@main`) and a pre-commit hook. PreCommit.md covers git core.hooksPath, the pre-commit framework and Husky, and says TruffleHog auto-detects the hook context and applies optimal settings.
Output formats are JSON (`--json`) and SARIF (`--sarif`) for GitHub code scanning. SARIF results are buffered in memory for the whole scan and written at the end.
'Checksums are applied to all artifacts, and the resulting checksum file is signed using cosign'. The install script's `-v` verifies the signature.
A `trufflehog:ignore` comment on the secret's line suppresses a finding if the source supports line numbers. `--no-ignore-tag` reports such findings anyway.
Flag `--no-update`: 'Don't check for updates.' (README has no telemetry section.)
Custom regex detectors (alpha) can verify via a user-run webhook (JSON POST; 200 OK = verified). The `verify` block is optional.
Library use: 'no guarantees can be made on the stability of the public APIs'. Released under AGPL-3.0; a CLA is required to contribute.

install.method: Install script, Linux/macOS (default bindir ./bin; append a release tag such as v3.56.0 to pin, README.md:141)
Install script with cosign signature verification of the checksum file (requires cosign)
Docker (Linux/macOS; add `--platform linux/arm64` on Apple Silicon, README.md:110)
Homebrew (macOS). The README does not say whether this resolves to homebrew-core or the project's own tap, which the release pipeline updates (.goreleaser.yml:123-134).
Binary release download plus manual cosign/sha256 verification (README.md:144-179)
Compile from source (Go; go.mod requires go 1.25.0, go.mod:3)
install.command: git clone https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog.git; cd trufflehog; go install

platforms.linux_x86_64: yes: release builds for linux/amd64 (.goreleaser.yml:14-26), installer maps linux/amd64 (scripts/install.sh:74), Docker image for linux/amd64 (.goreleaser.yml:44-58).
platforms.wsl2: yes (docs mention only): PreCommit.md:21 names WSL as covered by the install script. No WSL-specific CI or notes found; WSL2 would run the Linux build (scripts/install.sh:74-75).
platforms.macos_arm64: yes: darwin/arm64 builds (.goreleaser.yml:27-37), installer maps darwin/arm64 (scripts/install.sh:73), README Docker note for M1/M2 (README.md:107-111), Homebrew (README.md:82).
platforms.gpu: no: not applicable. CPU-only scanner; no GPU code found (a cuda/gpu/nvidia search only hit unrelated detector names such as pkg/detectors/nvapi/nvapi.go).

integrations.cli: Yes. `trufflehog <subcommand>` with git, github, github-experimental, gitlab, filesystem, s3, gcs, syslog, circleci, docker, travisci, postman, elasticsearch, jenkins, huggingface, stdin, multi-scan, json-enumerator, analyze (main.go:100-295; README.md:432-586). CI: composite GitHub Action that runs the Docker image (action.yml:33-111), GitLab CI snippet (README.md:808-831), `--sarif` for code-scanning upload (README.md:786-795), exit code 183 via `--fail` (README.md:697-701). Hooks: PreCommit.md (core.hooksPath, pre-commit framework, Husky) and root .pre-commit-hooks.yaml:1-6 (language: golang). Interactive TUI when run with no args on a TTY (main.go:345-369).
integrations.mcp: none found (repo-wide case-insensitive search for 'mcp' and 'model context protocol' returned nothing relevant).
integrations.sdk_or_api: No hosted API or server mode. The Go module github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/v3 can be imported, but README says no API stability guarantees (README.md:893-896). Config-driven scanning via `multi-scan` with YAML `sources:` (README.md:594-619). `stdin` and `json-enumerator` subcommands accept piped input (main.go:289-293; README.md:393-397). Custom detectors can call a user-run verification webhook (README.md:847-849).
integrations.claude_code_or_codex: none found. The only agent-related file is .cursor/skills/dep-updates/SKILL.md, a Cursor skill for maintainers' dependency updates, not an end-user integration.

readme.telemetry_and_network:
README has no telemetry section. Facts from code:
(1) Update check on by default in release builds. Each run POSTs JSON {OS, Arch, CurrentVersion, Cmd (subcommand), TUI, Timezone, Binary} to https://oss.trufflehog.org/updates. The response is treated as a tar.gz/zip holding a replacement `trufflehog` binary that the overseer library is wired to swap in (pkg/updater/updater.go:39-124; main.go:424-442; overseer internals not inspected, not in the working dir). Disabled by `--no-update` (main.go:76) and when version.BuildVersion == "dev", the default for source builds (main.go:438-440; pkg/version/version.go:3). action.yml:109 passes --no-update; the PreCommit.md and README Docker/CLI examples do not.
(2) Verification: outbound requests to each detected credential's provider (SECURITY.md:9-10). Off with `--no-verification` (main.go:60). Custom endpoints via `--verifier` and `--custom-verifiers-only` (main.go:79-80) or custom-detector webhooks (http:// requires `unsafe: true`, pkg/custom_detectors/validation.go:55-62). Private keys additionally GET https://keychecker.trufflesecurity.com/fingerprint/<hex> and attempt SSH logins to github.com and gitlab.com (pkg/detectors/privatekey/privatekey.go:106-154,222-223).
(3) GitHub REST API call to resolve the date of `--since-commit` for github.com URLs (pkg/sources/git/git.go:1517-1526).
(4) HTTP clients send `User-Agent: TruffleHog[ <suffix>]` and honour proxy env vars (pkg/common/http.go:92-101,247-257).
(5) Sentry hooks exist (pkg/log/log.go:42-108; pkg/common/recover.go) but no non-test code creates a Sentry client or DSN. Prometheus metrics are registered in-process; no metrics HTTP endpoint found.
(6) `--profile` starts pprof/fgprof on :18066 (main.go:496-507). The `syslog` source opens a listener (main.go:201-206).
(7) Accounts: none needed for local scans. Per-source tokens come via flags or env (GITHUB_TOKEN main.go:120; the GitLab token is required, main.go:152).
(8) `github-experimental --object-discovery` writes state files under $HOME/.trufflehog (README.md:361).

entry_points.what: package main: kingpin CLI declaring all subcommands and flags (main.go:46-295); main() wraps run() in the overseer self-updater (main.go:407-446); run() builds engine.Config (main.go:448-738); runSingleScan() dispatches to engine.Scan* per subcommand (main.go:793-1297); isPreCommitHook() env detection (main.go:1389-1424).

Composite GitHub Action: picks base/head by event type, then runs `docker run ${IMAGE}:${VERSION} git file:///tmp/ --since-commit ... --branch ... --fail --no-update --github-actions` (action.yml:45-111). Default image ghcr.io/trufflesecurity/trufflehog:latest (action.yml:21-27).
Docker ENTRYPOINT wrapper: sets git safe.directory '*', runs /usr/bin/trufflehog, and re-parses the last argument through `bash -c` (entrypoint.sh:3-13; Dockerfile.goreleaser:9).
pre-commit.com hook manifest: `trufflehog git file://. --since-commit HEAD --results=verified --fail --trust-local-git-config`, language: golang (.pre-commit-hooks.yaml:1-6).
POSIX installer used by `curl | sh`: downloads release tarball, always checks SHA-256 against the checksums file, optional cosign verification with -v (scripts/install.sh:44-55,347-354).
Detector registry: buildDetectorList()/DefaultDetectors() (defaults.go:905-1934); 892 active entries, 28 commented out, with feature-flag gating at the end of the list.
Detector scaffolding generator (`go run hack/generate/generate.go detector <Name>`; hack/docs/Adding_Detectors_external.md:68-73).

code.architecture:
Single Go module github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/v3. Flow (docs/process_flow.md, docs/concurrency.md): sources -> units -> chunks -> Aho-Corasick keyword match -> detectors (regex, then optional verify) -> notifier -> printer.
- main.go parses flags, builds engine.Config and calls eng.ScanGit/ScanGitHub/ScanFileSystem/ScanS3/... (main.go:874-1266). `--since-commit` forces concurrency 1 (main.go:491-494).
- pkg/sources/*: one package per source (git, github, gitlab, filesystem, s3, gcs, docker, postman, jenkins, elasticsearch, huggingface, syslog, circleci, travisci, json_enumerator), driven by pkg/sources/source_manager.go; pkg/engine/<source>.go wrap each.
- Git source (pkg/sources/git/git.go): clones to a temp dir, or opens in place with --trust-local-git-config, then ScanRepo walks commits via pkg/gitparse (`git rev-list/log`; base-only ranges are `--all ^base`, gitparse.go:481-564). ScanStaged then scans `git diff --cached --diff-filter=AM` (gitparse.go:566-579; git.go:1175-1320): added/modified staged files only, no unstaged edits (git.go:1596-1597). Needs external `git` 2.20 to <3.0 (pkg/sources/git/README.md:41).
- Filesystem source (pkg/sources/filesystem/filesystem.go): walks files/dirs; symlinks skipped unless `--max-symlink-depth` > 0 (filesystem.go:110-111,165-170); no .gitignore handling found.
- pkg/decoders (base64, utf8, utf16, escaped-unicode, html; chained to `--max-decode-depth`, default 5, main.go:71) and pkg/handlers (archives, APK, AR, RPM) preprocess content.
- pkg/engine/engine.go: scanner/detector/verification-overlap/notifier worker pools, `trufflehog:ignore`, entropy and wordlist false-positive filters, result filtering by `--results` (engine.go:1318-1345); pkg/verificationcache holds an in-memory verification cache.
- pkg/detectors/<name>/: about 920 detector packages, each implementing FromData(ctx, verify, data); IDs in proto/detector_type.proto; generated protobuf in pkg/pb. Regex uses wasilibs/go-re2 (stdlib regexp banned by .golangci.yml:5-11).
- pkg/analyzer (`analyze`, 43 analyzers), pkg/custom_detectors (YAML regex detectors with webhook verification), pkg/output (plain, json, legacy_json, github_actions, sarif), pkg/updater (overseer fetcher), pkg/tui (Bubble Tea TUI), pkg/feature (runtime flags).
code.packaging_and_release: Tags v* trigger .github/workflows/release.yml (release.yml:3-6): GoReleaser Pro (`distribution: goreleaser-pro`, needs GORELEASER_KEY, release.yml:66-75) with cosign installed (release.yml:41-42). .goreleaser.yml builds with CGO_ENABLED=0: linux amd64/arm64 (UPX-compressed), darwin and windows amd64/arm64 (:13-37). Archives contain LICENSE, README.md and docs/man/trufflehog.1 (:38-42). The checksums file is signed with cosign keyless via GitHub OIDC, producing .sig and .pem (:135-146). Multi-arch Docker images (linux/amd64 and linux/arm64/v8) go to Docker Hub trufflesecurity/trufflehog and ghcr.io/trufflesecurity/trufflehog with :<version> and :latest manifests (:43-122), labelled AGPL-3.0, with `--provenance=false`. The Homebrew tap trufflesecurity/homebrew-trufflehog is updated (:123-134). The release is created with make_latest:false and promoted by the `mark-latest` job (release.yml:77-96; .goreleaser.yml:6-12). release-bot.yml runs a Truffle-internal GCP release bot on publish. No SBOM, SLSA/provenance attestation or Docker image signing is configured; only the checksums file is signed. Third-party Actions are pinned by commit SHA. Dockerfile builds from golang:bullseye (unpinned tag) onto alpine:3.22 (Dockerfile:1,11); Dockerfile.goreleaser uses alpine:3.22 (:1). Neither sets USER (runs as root).
code.tests_and_ci:
Go `testing` with testify (go.mod:92), go-cmp, gock, rapid and testcontainers (go.mod:93-98). Tests are co-located `*_test.go` under pkg/: at least 2,000 files (the Glob tool capped at 2,000): pkg/detectors 1,857 (917 are `*_integration_test.go` behind `//go:build detectors` that fetch real credentials from GCP Secret Manager project `trufflehog-testing`, e.g. pkg/detectors/anthropic/anthropic_integration_test.go:1-24), pkg/analyzer 45, pkg/sources 44 (some tagged `integration`/`localInfra`), pkg/engine 8, plus others. No root-level main_test.go, so main.go's hook override is untested; git_test.go:1955-2096 does cover the HEAD..HEAD staged-only range.
Workflows (.github/workflows):
- test.yml (PR, push to main, tags): gotestsum running `go test -json -tags=sources` over all packages except pkg/analyzer/analyzers, with GCP workload identity. No code in the repo uses a `sources` build tag. Fork PRs run `make test-community` (Makefile:65-66).
- lint.yml: golangci-lint v2.13.2 plus bodyclose/copyloopvar/misspell, a man-page staleness check, semgrep detector rules, hack/checksecretparts.
- smoke.yml: builds and scans public repos; checks for leftover git processes and zombies (#3379).
- detector-tests.yml: nightly 08:00 UTC `captain run detectors`, which runs `go test -tags=detectors ./pkg/detectors/...` (.captain/config.yaml:3).
- detector-corpora-test.yml: on PRs touching detectors, regex-match diff vs main over an S3 corpus, posted as a PR comment.
- performance.yml: PR gate on average user time of 5 `filesystem --no-verification` scans of a v3.75.1 checkout, current vs previous tag. It fails above 1.5x although its message says 10% (performance.yml:92-95).
- codeql-analysis.yml (Go; push, PR, weekly), secrets.yml (dogfoods the action with --results=verified), release.yml, release-bot.yml.
CI uses Go 1.27 while go.mod declares go 1.25.0.
code.dependencies: One manifest: root go.mod (only go.mod in the repo). 109 direct requirements (go.mod:13-121) and 202 `// indirect` (go.mod:125-326); go 1.25.0, toolchain go1.25.10 (go.mod:3-5). Two `replace` directives point to Truffle-maintained forks: jpillora/overseer -> trufflesecurity/overseer v1.2.8, and coinbase/waas-client-library-go -> trufflesecurity fork v1.0.9 (go.mod:7,10). Notable direct deps: kingpin v2 (CLI), overseer (self-update), go-git, wasilibs/go-re2, BobuSumisu/aho-corasick, AWS SDK v2, cloud.google.com/go/{storage,secretmanager}, go-containerregistry, bubbletea (TUI), sentry-go/zapsentry, prometheus client, protobuf. testcontainers, gock and rapid sit in the same direct block. Renovate manages updates (.github/renovate.json:3). The newest dated pseudo-version is trufflesecurity/ldap-verify, 2026-08-24 (go.mod:100).
code.security_policy: SECURITY.md: report to security@trufflesec.com with `trufflehog` in the subject. Blind SSRF and outbound-request reports are treated as hardening, not vulnerabilities. A CVE is issued only for a demonstrated exploit chain such as credential exfiltration or internal exploitation (SECURITY.md:1-51). No supported-versions table.

claim_checks.claim: Classifies over 800 secret types (README.md:49) and has over 700 detectors with active verification (README.md:416).
claim_checks.evidence: pkg/engine/defaults/defaults.go:905-1913 registers 892 active `&pkg.Scanner{}` entries (28 more are commented out; regex counts). proto/detector_type.proto:7 has an enum of about 1,032 numbered entries. 917 of 920 non-test detector files under pkg/detectors contain an `if verify`-style branch (regex count, approximate). The count includes versioned variants (e.g. accuweather v1/v2, defaults.go:910-911), so 'types' is looser than 'entries'. main.go:555-591 enables all feature-gated detectors in the OSS build.

claim_checks.claim: For every classifiable secret it can also log in to confirm it is live (README.md:53). The AWS detector performs GetCallerIdentity (README.md:430).
claim_checks.evidence: AWS verification is real: STS GetCallerIdentity at pkg/detectors/aws/access_keys/accesskey.go:258-306. But README's link target pkg/detectors/aws/aws.go does not exist; the dir holds access_keys/, session_keys/, appsync/, common.go and utils.go. 'Every' is not confirmed: 917 of 920 detector files have a verify branch (regex count). A private key counts as 'verified' if a GitHub/GitLab SSH login succeeds or its public-key fingerprint is found in Truffle's keychecker index (pkg/detectors/privatekey/privatekey.go:106-168,222-239); no live TLS handshake exists in this code, despite README.md:406. The 'millions of users / billions of certificates' scale (README.md:418) is server-side and not checkable here.

claim_checks.claim: Results come in three statuses: verified, unverified, unknown (README.md:424-428).
claim_checks.evidence: main.go:1299-1321 parses `--results` (verified, unknown, unverified, filtered_unverified). The notifier classifies by Verified and VerificationError() and filters accordingly (pkg/engine/engine.go:1318-1344). Nil `--results` means all three are reported (engine.go:334-348, 397-402).

Exit 183 happens when engine.HasFoundResults() and --fail (main.go:733-737). The counter increments for any result that passes the `--results` filter (engine.go:1345). Unverified or unknown matches therefore fail the run unless `--results=verified` is set; the flag's own help text says 'if results are found' (main.go:77). Error exit is 1 (main.go:1325-1335).

claim_checks.claim: Pre-commit mode auto-detects the hook context and applies optimal settings: staged-only scan, only verified+unknown shown, fail on findings (PreCommit.md:47,116,175; pkg/sources/git/README.md:298-303).
claim_checks.evidence: main.go:896-915 does set base=head=HEAD (empty commit range, staged only), trust-local-git-config and fail=true; that range behaviour is tested in pkg/sources/git/git_test.go:2059-2076. But `*results = "verified,unknown"` at main.go:910 comes after parseResults (main.go:641) and after the engine was built from engConf (main.go:666,846), and `results` is never read again. From reading the code (not executed), the override has no effect, so the zero-flag hook reports and fails on unverified matches too, contrary to the docs. Detection env vars are PRE_COMMIT=1, HUSKY=1, HUSKY_GIT_PARAMS and TRUFFLEHOG_PRE_COMMIT=1 (main.go:1389-1424). No root-level test covers the override.

claim_checks.claim: Local git repos are cloned to a temp dir before scanning (CVE-2025-41390 guard); `--clone-path` and `--trust-local-git-config` adjust this (README.md:280).
claim_checks.evidence: pkg/sources/git/git.go:1576-1593: file:// URIs clone via CloneRepo unless trustLocalGitConfig, in which case the path is used in place. The index is copied and an alternates file added so staged blobs stay visible (git.go:1595-1634). Flags at main.go:109-111. The hook override turns trust on (main.go:901).

claim_checks.claim: GitHub Action scans only the commits in the push/PR and fails on findings (README.md:705-728).
claim_checks.evidence: action.yml:58-97 derives base/head from the event (push, pull_request, workflow_dispatch/schedule); action.yml:101-111 runs the Docker image with --since-commit, --branch, --fail, --no-update and --github-actions. It needs Docker, uses jq (apt-get fallback), pulls ghcr.io/trufflesecurity/trufflehog:latest by default (action.yml:21-27), and relies on the caller's full-depth checkout (README.md:718-721).

claim_checks.claim: Checksums cover all artifacts and the checksum file is cosign-signed (README.md:146).
claim_checks.evidence: .goreleaser.yml:135-146 (`signs` with cosign sign-blob, GitHub OIDC issuer, artifacts: checksum). scripts/install.sh:347-354 verifies with an identity regexp bound to this repo's workflows. Only the checksum file is signed; no docker_signs, sboms or attestations exist, and Docker builds use --provenance=false (.goreleaser.yml:58,74,89,105).

claim_checks.claim: `--no-update`: 'Don't check for updates.' (README.md:490); README mentions no telemetry.
claim_checks.evidence: The default 'check' is a POST of OS, arch, version, subcommand, TUI flag and timezone to https://oss.trufflehog.org/updates, and the answer can be a replacement binary (pkg/updater/updater.go:39-124; main.go:424-442). main.go:430 is a TODO for a PreUpgrade signature check, so none is configured. `--no-update` and dev builds skip it (main.go:438-440; pkg/version/version.go:3). README's wording undersells this behaviour.

claim_checks.claim: A `trufflehog:ignore` comment suppresses a finding where the source supports line numbers (README.md:407-410).
claim_checks.evidence: pkg/engine/engine.go:1285-1304 drops a result whose line carries the tag unless --no-ignore-tag (main.go:69); the tag is matched at engine.go:1448. SupportsLineNumbers is true only for git, github, gitlab, bitbucket, gerrit, azure repos, filesystem and a few related source types (engine.go:1388-1400), so findings from S3, GCS, Docker, Postman etc. cannot be inline-ignored.

benchmarks.what: Filesystem scan of the trufflehog repo (~4,500 files), `--no-verification --concurrency=1`, varying `--max-decode-depth`
benchmarks.value: depth 1: 8.05 s; depth 2: 8.18 s; depth 3: 8.09 s; depth 5 (default): 8.19 s; depth 10: 8.35 s. Hardware not stated.

benchmarks.what: Same scan: unique results found at each decode depth
benchmarks.value: 924 (depth 1), 927 (2), 928 (3), 928 (5), 932 (10). The doc attributes the depth-10 variance to nondeterministic dedup ordering.

benchmarks.what: base64 decoder microbenchmark on random data
benchmarks.value: 100 B: ~250 ns (96 B, 2 allocs); 1 KB: ~2.25 us; 10 KB: ~44 ns (fast because random bytes rarely contain a valid base64 run). Hardware not stated.

benchmarks.what: Average user CPU time of `trufflehog git file://<repo> --no-verification --no-update` per release, v3.26.0 to v3.33.0 (script hack/bench/versions.sh, num_iterations=5)
benchmarks.value: v3.28.6 to v3.33.0 excluding v3.31.3-v3.31.6: 1.298-1.402 s. v3.31.3-v3.31.6: 2.418-2.470 s. v3.26.0-v3.28.5: 2.538-2.596 s. The repo under test is not recorded in plot.txt. versions.sh:57 uses `for i in {1..$num_iterations}`, which bash does not expand, so each figure may be a single run divided by 5 (my reading, not executed). Releases are old relative to v3.97.9; no current numbers are published.

risks: Self-update and phone-home are on by default in release binaries and Docker images. Every run POSTs OS, arch, version, subcommand, TUI flag and timezone to oss.trufflehog.org and may swap in a downloaded binary via overseer (pkg/updater/updater.go:39-124; main.go:424-442). main.go:430 still has a TODO for a PreUpgrade signature check. Opt out with `--no-update` (main.go:76); only action.yml:109 passes it, while the PreCommit.md hook examples and README Docker/CLI examples do not. Source builds report version 'dev' and skip the updater (main.go:438-440; pkg/version/version.go:3). README documents it only as 'Don't check for updates' (README.md:490).

Verification sends found secrets off-machine and has offline pitfalls (code reading, not executed). It is on by default and calls each provider's API with the candidate credential (SECURITY.md:9-10; main.go:60,656; e.g. AWS STS in pkg/detectors/aws/access_keys/accesskey.go:258-306). Private keys: the fingerprint goes to keychecker.trufflesecurity.com and SSH logins are attempted against github.com and gitlab.com (pkg/detectors/privatekey/privatekey.go:106-168,222-239). Network failures become 'unknown' results that count toward `--fail` when `unknown` is selected (pkg/engine/engine.go:1323-1345). With `--no-verification` every match is 'unverified', which the documented `--results=verified,unknown` setting drops (engine.go:334-348,1334-1338). I found no non-test caller of the AWS account allow/deny filter (pkg/detectors/account_filter.go), so verification cannot be limited to chosen accounts from the CLI.

Pre-commit auto-configuration differs from its docs (code reading, not executed). In hook mode, main.go:896-915 forces staged-only, trust-local-git-config and --fail, but the results override at main.go:910 runs after the filter was parsed (main.go:641-666) and the engine built (main.go:846), so it is inert. The zero-flag hook (`trufflehog git file://.`, PreCommit.md:47-53) therefore also reports and fails on unverified matches, contrary to pkg/sources/git/README.md:300-303. No root-level test covers it. The 'manual' configs (`--since-commit HEAD` with no `--branch`, PreCommit.md:58-61,137,182) outside a detected hook context walk `--all ^HEAD`, i.e. every ref not reachable from HEAD, plus staged changes (pkg/gitparse/gitparse.go:517-535; pkg/sources/git/git_test.go:1948-1958). Staged scanning covers added/modified files only (gitparse.go:569).

Plain and JSON output contain the full secret value (`Raw`, `RawV2`, `SecretParts`), so logs, CI artifacts or files saved in the checkout can themselves hold live credentials (pkg/output/plain.go:66; pkg/output/json.go:48-58,71-76). SARIF and GitHub-Actions output omit the value (pkg/output/sarif.go:81-94,195-206; pkg/output/github_actions.go:55-61). Source credentials are accepted as flags or URL userinfo (pkg/sources/git/README.md:96-100; main.go:120,152). By default tokens are handed to `git` as a `-c http.extraHeader=Authorization: Basic ...` argument, or embedded in the URL with `--auth-in-url` (pkg/sources/git/git.go:628-645).

No baseline or allowlist file. Suppression is limited to inline `trufflehog:ignore` (only for git, github, gitlab, filesystem and similar sources, pkg/engine/engine.go:1388-1400), regex path files (`--include-paths`/`--exclude-paths`) and detector include/exclude lists (main.go:85-86). Findings from sources without line numbers (S3, GCS, Docker, Postman, ...) cannot be inline-ignored.

Licensing and stability. AGPL-3.0 (LICENSE; README.md:12,900) with no per-file headers and no '-only' or '-or-later' statement found; contributions require a CLA (CONTRIBUTING.md:7). README says there is no API stability guarantee for library use (README.md:893-896); custom regex detectors are labelled alpha 'subject to change' (README.md:857) and `github-experimental` is alpha (README.md:355).

Release and supply-chain hygiene. Only the checksums file is cosign-signed (.goreleaser.yml:135-146); no SBOM, provenance attestation or Docker signing is configured, and Docker builds use --provenance=false (.goreleaser.yml:58,74,89,105). The install script checks SHA-256 from the same release host and runs cosign only with `-v` (scripts/install.sh:44-55); README's `curl | sh` pulls the script from the `main` branch (README.md:129). Linux binaries are UPX-packed (.goreleaser.yml:14-26). The Action is documented as `@main` and defaults to the `latest` image (README.md:723; action.yml:21-27). The release needs GoReleaser Pro (release.yml:67-75), and two dependencies are redirected to Truffle-maintained forks (go.mod:7,10).

Operational footguns. The git source needs `git` 2.20 to <3.0 on PATH (pkg/sources/git/README.md:41). `--since-commit` forces concurrency 1 (main.go:491-494). Default local scans first clone the repo to a temp dir (pkg/sources/git/git.go:1576-1593). With `--clone-path` set and no `--no-cleanup`, an in-place scan (`--trust-local-git-config`, or `directories` in YAML) deletes the scanned directory (pkg/sources/git/README.md:201; git.go:387-397). In-place directories whose path ends in 'git' are skipped silently (git.go:373-376). `--profile` binds pprof/fgprof on all interfaces at :18066 (main.go:496-507). The Docker image runs as root (Dockerfile.goreleaser has no USER) and its entrypoint passes the last argument through `bash -c`, so word-splitting, globbing and command substitution apply (entrypoint.sh:3-4). Detector verification tests need project-held GCP secrets, so only maintainers run them (pkg/detectors/anthropic/anthropic_integration_test.go:1-24; .github/workflows/test.yml:13).

But `*results = "verified,unknown"` at main.go:910 runs after parseResults (main.go:641) and after the engine is built from engConf (main.go:666,846), and `results` is never read again, so the override is inert. checks.note: The evidence matches the code. main.go:901-914 sets TrustLocalGitConfig, BaseRef and HeadRef to HEAD, `*results`, and `*fail`. The only read of `results` is parseResults at main.go:641 (grep finds uses only at lines 62, 639, 641 and 910; manpage.go does not use it). engConf.Results (line 666) goes to engine.NewEngine at line 846, which applies the filter once at engine.go:334-348 (after setDefaults at line 279). Writing `*results` at line 910 therefore cannot change filtering. `*fail` is read later, at main.go:733, so that override does take effect. With no flags, Results is nil, setDefaults notifies all three statuses (engine.go:400-402), and every notified result increments numFoundResults (engine.go:1345). Unverified matches therefore trigger exit 183, contrary to pkg/sources/git/README.md:302. The doc claims at PreCommit.md:47, 116 and 175 match the dossier's description. git_test.go:2059-2076 tests the HEAD..HEAD staged-only shape. No main_test.go exists.
